angles.angle: Cheaper travel and social media exposure have driven the tourism boom
angles.example: budget airlines and Instagram-worthy locations push more people to travel than a generation ago

angles.angle: Overtourism can erode the very culture that attracts visitors in the first place
angles.example: a historic old town overwhelmed by tour groups loses the authentic daily life that made it charming

angles.angle: Virtual reality can supplement but is unlikely to replace travel because of the sensory and social dimension of being there
angles.example: VR can show you the Louvre, but it can't replicate the smell of a Parisian street or a conversation with a local
expressions: the lived experience of a place

angles.angle: Quota systems and seasonal pricing are practical tools governments use to manage overtourism
angles.example: some cities now charge entry fees during peak season to spread out visitor numbers

angles.angle: Tourism can fund conservation when managed well, creating a positive feedback loop
angles.example: entrance fees to national parks are often reinvested in wildlife protection
